arxiv-1807-10051.title: PCach: The Case for Pre-Caching your Mobile Data
arxiv-1807-10051.creator: Katia Jaffrès-Runser, Gentian Jakllari
arxiv-1807-10051.description: Abstract We present PCach, a smartphone-based approach for relieving the congestion in cellular network resulting from the exponential growth in mobile data traffic. The basic idea underlying PCach is simple: use WiFi to proactively cache content on the smartphone’s memory, which otherwise would have been delivered through the cellular network.

arxiv-2110-03125.title: Explaining the 𝑹 𝑲 ( ∗ ) R_{K^{(*)}} anomalies in a Fundamental Composite Higgs Model with Gauged 𝑼 ​ ( 𝟏 ) 𝑺 ​ 𝑴 𝟑 − 𝑯 ​ 𝑩 U(1)_{SM_{3}-HB}
arxiv-2110-03125.creator: Yi Chung
arxiv-2110-03125.description: Abstract A new heavy Z ′ Z^{\prime} vector boson provides a possible explanation for the neutral current B anomalies. Various U ​ ( 1 ) ′ U(1)^{\prime} gauge groups have been proposed and studied. In this paper, we explore a new type of U ​ ( 1 ) ′ U(1)^{\prime} gauge symmetry inspired by fundamental composite Higgs models with hyperfermions.

arxiv-2209-09175.title: Exponential Family Trend Filtering on Lattices
arxiv-2209-09175.creator: Veeranjaneyulu Sadhanala, Robert Bassett, James Sharpnack, Daniel J. McDonald
arxiv-2209-09175.description: Abstract Trend filtering is a modern approach to nonparametric regression that is more adaptive to local smoothness than splines or similar basis procedures. Existing analyses of trend filtering focus on estimating a function corrupted by homoskedastic Gaussian noise, but our work extends this technique to general exponential family distributions.

arxiv-2211-07556.title: Utilizing Synthetic Data in Supervised Learning for Robust 5-DoF Magnetic Marker Localization
arxiv-2211-07556.creator: Mengfan Wu, Thomas Langerak, Otmar Hilliges, Juan Zarate
arxiv-2211-07556.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Tracking passive magnetic markers plays a vital role in advancing healthcare and robotics, offering the potential to significantly improve the precision and efficiency of systems. This technology is key to developing smarter, more responsive tools and devices, such as enhanced surgical instruments, precise diagnostic tools, and robots with improved environmental interaction capabilities.

arxiv-2301-09664.title: A Useful Inequality for the Binary Entropy Function
arxiv-2301-09664.creator: Ravi B. Boppana
arxiv-2301-09664.description: Abstract We provide a simple proof of a curious inequality for the binary entropy function, an inequality that has been used in two different contexts. In the 1980’s, Boppana used this entropy inequality to prove lower bounds on Boolean formulas. More recently, the inequality was used to achieve major progress on Frankl’s union-closed sets conjecture.

arxiv-2306-17844.title: The Clock and the Pizza: Two Stories in Mechanistic Explanation of Neural Networks
arxiv-2306-17844.creator: Ziqian Zhong*, Ziming Liu*, Max Tegmark, Jacob Andreas
arxiv-2306-17844.description: Abstract Do neural networks, trained on well-understood algorithmic tasks, reliably rediscover known algorithms for solving those tasks? Several recent studies, on tasks ranging from group arithmetic to in-context linear regression, have suggested that the answer is yes. Using modular addition as a prototypical problem, we show that algorithm discovery in neural networks is sometimes more complex.

arxiv-2406-11377.title: Vague and basic convergence of signed measures
arxiv-2406-11377.creator: Michael Staněk
arxiv-2406-11377.description: Abstract Abstract We study the relationship between different kinds of convergence of finite signed measures and discuss their metrizability. In particular, we study the concept of basic convergence recently introduced by Khartov [ 11 ] and introduce the related concept of almost basic convergence.

arxiv-2410-00789.title: SRF programs towards High-Q/High-G cavities in IJCLab
arxiv-2410-00789.creator: \firstname Akira \lastname Miyazaki \fnsep, \firstname Mohammed \lastname Fouaidy \fnsep, \firstname Nicolas \lastname Gandolfo \fnsep, \firstname David \lastname Longuevergne \fnsep, \firstname Guillaume \lastname Olry \fnsep, \firstname Mael \lastname Vannson \fnsep, \firstname Lê My \lastname Vog
arxiv-2410-00789.description: Abstract IJCLab has been leading the development and deployment of low- β \beta Superconducting Radio Frequency (SRF) cavities for proton and heavy ion accelerators. We are launching an electron accelerator project for sustainable Energy Recovery Linac (iSAS/PERLE) with state-of-the-art SRF cavities at 800MHz.

arxiv-2411-14891.title: The non-equilibrium Marshak wave problem in non-homogeneous media
arxiv-2411-14891.creator: Nitay Derei, Shmuel Balberg, Shay I. Heizler, Elad Steinberg, Ryan G. McClarren, Menahem Krief
arxiv-2411-14891.description: Abstract We derive a family of similarity solutions to the nonlinear non-equilibrium Marshak wave problem for an inhomogeneous planar medium which is coupled to a time dependent radiation driving source. We employ the non-equilibrium gray diffusion approximation in the supersonic regime. The solutions constitute a generalization of the non-equilibrium nonlinear solutions that were developed recently for homogeneous media.

arxiv-2502-04356.title: Open Foundation Models in Healthcare: Challenges, Paradoxes, and Opportunities with GenAI Driven Personalized Prescription
arxiv-2502-04356.creator: Mahdi Alkaeed, Sofiat Abioye, Adnan Qayyum, Yosra Magdi Mekki, Ilhem Berrou, Mohamad Abdallah, Ala Al-Fuqaha, Muhammad Bilal, Junaid Qadir
arxiv-2502-04356.description: Abstract In response to the success of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI’s GPT-4, there is a growing interest in developing open, non-proprietary LLMs and AI foundation models (AIFMs) for transparent use in academic, scientific, and non-commercial applications.

arxiv-2504-00259.title: Orthogonalization and polarization of Yangians
arxiv-2504-00259.creator: Wolfgang Bock, Vyacheslav Futorny, Mikhail Neklyudov, Jian Zhang
arxiv-2504-00259.description: Abstract For every family of orthogonal polynomials, we define a new realization of the Yangian of 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 n {\mathfrak{gl}}_{n} . Except in the case of Dickson polynomials, the new realizations do not satisfy the RTT relation. We obtain an analogue of the Christoffel-Darboux formula.

arxiv-2507-04991.title: Paired Explicit Relaxation Runge-Kutta Methods: Entropy-Conservative and Entropy-Stable High-Order Optimized Multirate Time Integration Journal: ??
arxiv-2507-04991.creator: Daniel Doehring, Hendrik Ranocha, and Manuel Torrilhon
arxiv-2507-04991.description: Abstract We present novel entropy-conservative and entropy-stable multirate Runge-Kutta methods based on Paired Explicit Runge-Kutta (P-ERK) schemes with relaxation for conservation laws and related systems of partial differential equations. Optimized schemes up to fourth-order of accuracy are derived and validated in terms of order of consistency, conservation of linear invariants, and entropy conservation/stability.

arxiv-2509-23495.title: Energy minimization for skyrmions on planar thin films Thanks: G. Di F., M. I., and D. P. acknowledge support through the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) through the doctoral school Dissipation and dispersion in nonlinear PDEs (grant W1245) and the special research program Taming complexity in partial d
arxiv-2509-23495.creator: Giovanni Di Fratta, Michael Innerberger, Dirk Praetorius, Valeriy Slastikov
arxiv-2509-23495.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Giovanni Di Fratta, Michael Innerberger, Dirk Praetorius, Valeriy Slastikov. We consider an energy functional that arises in micromagnetic and liquid crystal theory on thin films. In particular, our energy comprises a non-convex term that models anti-symmetric exchange as well as an anisotropy term. We devise an algorithm for energy minimization in the continuous case and show weak convergence of a subsequence towards a solution of the corresponding Euler–Lagrange equation. Furthermore, an algorithm for numerical energy minimization is presented.

pmc-10693634.creator: Alvin X. Han, Emma Hannay, Sergio Carmona, Bill Rodriguez, Brooke E. Nichols, Colin A. Russell

pmc-11505383.title: Immunopeptidomics of Salmonella enterica Serovar Typhimurium-Infected Pig Macrophages Genotyped for Class II Molecules
pmc-11505383.creator: Carmen Celis-Giraldo, Carlos F. Suárez, William Agudelo, Nieves Ibarrola, Rosa Degano, Jaime Díaz, Raúl Manzano-Román, Manuel A. Patarroyo
pmc-11505383.description: Simple SummarySubunit vaccines based on peptides as minimal immunogenic epitopes/antigens can induce highly specific immune responses without triggering adverse reactions. Here, Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium peptides were identified in the immunopeptidome of porcine macrophages genotyped for different class II molecules that were stimulated with the bacteria.

pmc-11545066.title: Brainstem Toxicity Following Proton Beam Radiation Therapy in Pediatric Brain Tumors: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11545066.creator: Abdulrahim Saleh Alrasheed, Abdulsalam Mohammed Aleid, Reema Ahmed Alharbi, Mostafa Habeeb Alhodibi, Abdulmonem Ali Alhussain, Awn Abdulmohsen Alessa, Sami Fadhel Almalki
pmc-11545066.description: Simple SummaryProton beam radiation therapy is one of the major treatment modalities used for cancer treatment, including brain tumors. This treatment modality is distinct from other radiation options because of its ability to deliver radiation to tumor targets while sparing healthy tissue.

pmc-11618281.title: Unraveling molecular signatures and prognostic biomarkers in glioblastoma: a comprehensive study on treatment resistance and personalized strategies
pmc-11618281.creator: Jinmin Xue, Jie Zhang, Jing Zhu
pmc-11618281.description: BackgroundGlioblastoma (GBM) is a highly aggressive primary brain tumor with limited treatment success and poor prognosis. Despite surgical resection and adjuvant therapies, GBM often recurs, and resistance to radiotherapy and temozolomide presents significant challenges. This study aimed to elucidate molecular signatures associated with treatment responses, identify potential biomarkers, and enhance personalized treatment strategies for GBM.

pmc-11744474.title: Failed labral reconstruction of the hip can be successfully revised to another labral reconstruction: improved patient-reported outcomes at a minimum of 2-year follow-up
pmc-11744474.creator: Brian J White, R. Presley Swann, Hannah Spears, Anna Shafer, Shannon M Constantinides
pmc-11744474.description: The purpose of this study was to validate the success of revision arthroscopic circumferential allograft labral reconstruction (CLR) in nonarthritic hips, which, in the rare case of failure, had previously undergone labral reconstruction by the same surgeon. Using a minimum of 24-month follow-up, data from 24 hips having undergone revision CLR were analyzed to determine improvements in patient-reported outcomes (PROs).

pmc-13169145.title: A Quality Improvement Project to Limit Perioperative Transfusion During Craniofacial Surgery in Infants and Children
pmc-13169145.creator: Grace Parizek, Annie Drapeau, Jonathan Pindrik, Gregory Pearson, Joseph D. Tobias, Ashley Smith

We sought to address this through a multidisciplinary quality improvement approach to decrease variability in transfusion practices.
